title: Resilient HPC Workflows
prose: The most direct evidence of Mofka's impact is the set of systems that build on it as a core architectural component. StreamGuard wraps Mofka as its resilience communication layer, using Mofka topics to implement reliable producer-consumer streaming with exactly-once delivery semantics and QoS guarantees for real-time HPC data streams [ref:W7167027240]. This tight coupling demonstrates that Mofka's API and persistence guarantees are sufficient to ground a production resilience system, not merely to inform one.
